name: science
description: Primary scientific evidence: scholarly works from bounded scholarly APIs, study methodology records, paper families, public peer-review rounds, systematic reviews and preserved citations, and cultural primary sources (DDB, Europeana) linked to research works and places, with book, music and authority metadata (Open Library, MusicBrainz CC0 core data, Wikidata, DNB, Library of Congress) as their identity backbone; and mathematics: zbMATH Open literature, OEIS sequences and pinned formal-library declarations (Lean mathlib4, Isabelle AFP) with proof dependencies, revisions and reviewable cross-source links (acquired through config/source_packs/research.json). Life-science reference data: UniProtKB proteins, NCBI Gene and Taxonomy, RCSB PDB structures and ChEMBL targets, compounds and published activities with versions, cross-references and reviewable cross-source identity (the science.life-sciences provider).

query_examples.intent: Studies that used a randomized design
query_examples.semantics: bounded search over current study-method records; not a full-text literature search

query_examples.intent: Registration, replication, data and code links for a study
query_examples.semantics: bounded registration, replication, data, code and correction links recorded for the study

query_examples.intent: Which versions of a paper exist and which one to cite
query_examples.semantics: exact source versions with their access types; membership is curated, not inferred at query time
citations present in the document corpus only, bounded by depth and limit
only provider coordinates or gazetteer-resolved place names match; undated or unplaced objects never match; rights decide link-only access

query_examples.intent: Papers, sequences and formal declarations about Zeckendorf representations
query_examples.semantics: bounded search over acquired records; formal results pin the library commit and show explicit vs candidate links
contiguous term match over acquired OEIS entries only

query_examples.intent: A formal theorem and what it depends on at a fixed library revision
query_examples.semantics: lexical declaration scan; module imports are explicit, statement references are lexical, not elaborated

query_examples.intent: What changed in a formal library between two revisions
query_examples.semantics: declarations added/removed/changed by statement hash; renames are candidates

query_examples.intent: Which work and authority records does this ISBN, MBID or QID identify on a date
query_examples.semantics: exact identifier lookup: the identity, each authority record's source, revision and as-of time, identity matches used, redirects and merges; unknown or ambiguous identifiers are reported as such

query_examples.intent: Which works match this title and creator
query_examples.semantics: ranked candidates with title and name evidence, one per identity; never a single asserted answer and no popularity ranking

query_examples.intent: A protein entry as of a UniProt release with its structures, gene and targets
query_examples.semantics: the entry version in force at the release, its history and successors, and every cross-reference labelled with the source that asserts it; each entry version cited

query_examples.intent: Compounds with published activity against a target
query_examples.semantics: ChEMBL activities as published for the release, grouped by assay and activity type with relation, unit and validity comment; never converted, aggregated, ranked or predicted

query_examples.intent: Which projects, datasets and lineage does this organisation have in the registries on a date
query_examples.semantics: ROR relationships as published in the release in force, CORDIS participation through accepted matches with contributions per currency, datasets citing the organisation; every record version cited; no ranking

exclusions: automated inclusion decisions without human adjudication
automatic identity between a paper theorem and a formal theorem
university rankings, league tables, quality or composite scores
merged, averaged or harmonised education statistics
full text, audio, cover images and other media content
popularity rankings of works or recordings
rights clearance determinations from catalogue notes
biological or clinical inference from reference records
activity prediction, scoring or ranking of compounds
conversion or aggregation of activity values across assays
personal names of authors, depositors or submitters
personal data beyond the public ORCID fields allowed by the research-entities minimisation decision
